usage: 炸麵 is used to refer to a dish made of noodles that are deep-fried until crispy.
In sentences, 炸麵 usually acts as a noun and can be the subject or the object.
You can describe the taste or texture of 炸麵 by adding adjectives before it.
炸麵 can be combined with sauces or added as a topping in other dishes.
When ordering food, you can simply say 炸麵 to specify this crispy fried noodle dish.
